The user guide (capacity-reservations-release) and the 2026-06-02 history row say a future-dated reservation can be cancelled at any time, with a charge during the commitment or within 8 weeks of the start date.

No saved page states that new instance types are IMDSv2-only. The guide says by default either IMDSv1 or IMDSv2 can be used.
